full_judgment: 3. The case of the plaintiff, in short, is that the suit land is the property under Khas Khatian No. 1 of the Government. In the remark column of the said khatian it has been written useable by the people and in the CS Khatian there was a remark 'eidgah' in the remark column for which the suit land had not been given on pattan. The suit property is a ditch, pond and eidgah. A mosque has been built in some portion of the suit land. The local people use the land for a long period from time immemorial. But in the RS Khatian, there was no remark in the remark column of the plot as useable by the people. Defendant Nos.1-2 on 15-12-2003, refused the easement right of the people, hence the plaintiff filed the instant suit on the consent of all for declaration of the easement right over the suit land.
